digest.component_or_area: completion verifier wrapper and direct phase metrics instrumentation
propositions: 237.7 seconds of verifier_call_ms (423502 ms) remains unattributed when inner workflow metrics (llm_ms, det_ms, total_ms) total only 185.7 seconds across close wrapper, auto-resume setup, gate dispatch, and annotation layers.

Direct monotonic timers must partition the close wrapper interval into synchronous phases (setup, reusable lookup, resume config, attempts, finalization, handle resolution, dispatch, workflow) without adding I/O, subprocesses, network calls, retries, sleeps, locks, workers, or extra traversals.

Reconciliation arithmetic across named wrapper phases plus unattributed remainder must equal verifier_call_ms within 1 ms per phase and 10 ms absolute maximum; any larger discrepancy is labeled unattributed_verifier_ms with no causal inference.

Existing consumption/runtime metrics (llm_ms, det_ms, total_ms, requests, tool_calls, repeat/resume/drain counts) and non-instrumented caller behavior must remain unchanged under optional collector threading.
Direct phase timings and unattributed remainder must be added to COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics payload via existing write without new I/O, events, or backends.
